mailto: link with matching email text renders as autolink (#397)

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"mailto:a@b.com\">a@b.com</a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
